1.title: Why Our Poll Shows Democrats Leading Ahead of the Midterms
1.summary: Our polling reporter Ruth Igielnik describes what likely voters told us in the latest Times/Siena poll leading up to this year’s midterm elections.

2.title: A.I. Is Unpopular With Voters, a New York Times/Siena Poll Finds
2.summary: As fears grow about the threat of artificial intelligence, neither party has claimed an advantage on the technology, a New York Times/Siena poll found. But voters are united in opposition to data centers.

3.title: Trump criticises Supreme Court after justices block mail-in ballot restrictions
3.summary: The president assailed the justices for blocking his plan to allow delivery of ballots only to voters on lists of citizens.

4.title: Suspected sabotage causes major Netherlands rail disruption
4.summary: Trains were cancelled or delayed on Tuesday after objects were found on tracks at multiple locations.

5.title: Carney Pitches Canada as a Haven of Investment Stability in a Chaotic World
5.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney brought together in Toronto about 100 money managers overseeing much of the world’s wealth to promote Canada as an ideal place to invest.

6.title: Two sailors missing after tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz, Oman says
6.summary: Iran says El Gaia caught fire after hitting mines, but the US says the oil tanker was struck by a missile and then a drone.
